name: Xanthic-Polje
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by orbital debris ring and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls salvageable alloys controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
